visualReview.review: Reviewed desktop, mobile, official preview and two extra modal screenshots. Thick black window borders, hard offset shadows, massive serif hierarchy, raw monospace controls and original angular avatar follow the weirdcore brief without gradients or soft effects. Refined footer-button contrast and reran all checks. All six concept plates decode at full width; local viewer arrows/Escape, language availability notice, disclosures, randomized notes and text-download content were verified.
